script_text: Vault Notes, vaultnotes-9. This is an after-run replay of a lab exam, not a live attack. The agent LLM for this run was glm-5.3:cloud. 7 agents produced 413 events over a 1500-second window. Each row is one agent; each column is a stage, from human on the left to publish on the right. Most activity was in the proven-gate stage, with 362 events. The first publish came 168 seconds in. Coverage: 14 endpoints, 12 findings, 0 verified. Nearby dots are not proof that the agents coordinated.
